serving_and_CAL.comparison_scope: Compare complete fixed served procedures, preserving their native operator. Different backbones/selectors/calibration protocols are disclosed; this is not an isolated architecture effect or a probability/raw-logit pool swap. No fitted-CAL quality interpretation.

primary_quality.endpoint: Raw served CONFIRM accuracy difference in percentage points, SX4 minus reference.
primary_quality.test: One-sided paired t of mean difference>0, Holm familywise .05 across exactly these4 predeclared contrasts; no method/endpoint selection from outcomes.
primary_quality.success: Each contrast observed mean>=.25pp, all10 paired block differences strictly positive, and Holm-adjusted p<=.05. Point gain>=.25 is not a proof that the population effect exceeds.25.
primary_quality.report: All10 vectors, mean, paired SD, nominal paired95% t(df9) intervals labeled unadjusted, signs, leave-one-block-out means, raw/adjusted p, and all1024 sign-flip assignments as symmetry sensitivity.
primary_quality.uncertainty: Conditional one-graph optimizer/mask-block inference; approximate independence/regularity for paired t and symmetry for sign flips are assumptions, not established power. Ten blocks are not10 graphs; no node-iid SE/bootstrap. If uncertainty/assumptions make the conclusion fragile, report inconclusive, not more seeds.

current_pilot_gates_verbatim.scope: Exploratory three paired protocols on one graph. Complete block vectors/descriptive intervals/eight sign-flip assignments; no confirmatory p claim or node-as-independent replication. A complete useful result earns unused whole-pipeline confirmation priority.
current_pilot_gates_verbatim.competent_backbone_precondition: Before a positive shared attribution, F1 and I4 must not reveal material factor-induced competence collapse: F1-source P1 mean accuracy>=-.25pp and no block<-.5pp; I4 mean members-source P1 mean>=-.25pp and no block<-.5pp. Failure is a factorization competence finding, not a rescue to weaker references.
current_pilot_gates_verbatim.primary_quality: SX4 raw accuracy mean gain>=.25pp vs S4, P1, PA1, I4 and IA4; each paired block gain>0 against each. SX4-UX4 mean>=0 and no block harm>.25pp; this separate quality comparison needs no significance at3 blocks.
current_pilot_gates_verbatim.member_competence: SX4 mean own-member raw accuracy gain>=.25pp vs S4, all3 gains>0; SX4 mean members versus IA4 mean>=-.25pp and no block harm>.5pp. Report worst/all route accuracies too.
current_pilot_gates_verbatim.risk: SX4 calibrated DEVELOPMENT_EVAL NLL mean harm<=.02 and each block harm<=.05 against P1, PA1, I4, IA4 and UX4. Raw NLL mean harm<=.02 versus S4, SA4 and IA4. Report full raw/calibrated Brier without a post-result secondary winner.
current_pilot_gates_verbatim.mechanism: SX4-SA4 mean raw accuracy>=.10pp, each block>=0 for peer access; SX4-SM4 mean>=.10pp, each block>=0 for donor-before-mean nonlinearity. Failure narrows attribution even if generic feedback is useful. These controls do not prove global novelty or unique optimality.
current_pilot_gates_verbatim.retention: Exact coverage/pooling-loss/aggregation-only identity and all candidate-reference repair/harm pairs. SX4 pooling losses count must not exceed S4 or IA4 in the mean per block; otherwise reject a claim that this rule repairs the recorded pooling failure, even if accuracy is useful for another reason. No grouping weights or post hoc subgroup-primary gate.
current_pilot_gates_verbatim.after_failure: Close exact rank16/scale.25/site/operator recipe; no rescue coefficient/rank/site grid or old endpoint reinterpretation. No automatic study/source launch. If PA1/IA4/SA4 explain gains, retain attributed generic feature feedback and record shared gate failure.

separate_practical_attribution_and_loss_.quality_and_competence: Retain original SX4 worthwhile raw gains versus S4/P1/PA1/I4/IA4; UX4 mean nonharm0/no block harm>.25; F1 and I4 member competence versus P1; SX4 member gain/retention versus S4/IA4. separate_practical_attribution_and_loss_.mechanism: SX4−SA4 and SX4−SM4 remain decisive predeclared attribution contrasts: mean>=.10pp and each>=0, with full vectors/intervals. UX4 distinguishes complete tying under live coupling; it is not independent I4. A quality pass with failed attribution supports only the narrower surviving quality description, not a peer-order/sharing explanation.
separate_practical_attribution_and_loss_.proper_loss: Retain the original raw/calibrated NLL practical screens and full Brier. Report raw/calibrated NLL/Brier vectors and paired intervals against every reference. For the new primary PA36/original-GNNM references, predeclare calibrated NLL practical protection mean harm<=.02 and each<=.05; no new raw-NLL scale gate against the different native GNNM. These are practical safety screens, not statistical noninferiority or secondary winner selection.
separate_practical_attribution_and_loss_.pooling_and_uncertainty: Retain exact whole-population/class coverage−pooling-loss+aggregation-only identity, gross repairs/harms, same fresh S4 common-rival regions, and mean pooling-loss nonincrease versus S4/IA4. More hidden spread or coverage alone is not success. Do not infer novel primitives or uncertainty calibration from deterministic member disagreement.
